title: The Quiet Battlefield
text: An old battlefield lies very still, the grass grown over the bones. A sword stands upright in the middle of it, ringed by clean ground where nothing grows. A voice on the wind asks who among you fought best.

options.label: The one with the most kills steps up to claim the sword.

outcomes.text: The sword comes free in their hand. The wind sighs, satisfied.

options.label: The one who has saved the most lives steps up, calling that the better fighting.

outcomes.text: The sword stays put, but the wind says it was the right answer. Something settles in them.

options.label: Say nothing; the dead can judge for themselves.

outcomes.text: The wind waits a long time, then gives up. For a while the field's dead walk behind you like an honour guard.

options.label: The Sword Saint answers the voice, as one who has given their life to the blade.

outcomes.text: The sword comes out of the ground for them. It wants to fight again.
The sword comes out of the ground, and the field's dead rise with it to test whether the answer was true.
